The new checkpoint connects ordinary invariant-label structure with the actual canonical source flow, after refreshing the relevant PR176 and PR185 sources.

**Published head:** `9dacd610ba7735e89e2e29e4ab01795983317980`  
**Tree:** `7c394f8d8c30d00344624b9816120a7f4a8fadff`

The PR remains a draft stacked on PR173. The forced-band baseline is frozen at `fa0c9e2a2851e6324391e39c17afcb5913185aec`.

This checkpoint adds **22 audited Lean statements in two modules**, three independently reviewed written analytic notes, and their source/replay evidence. The earlier117 statements remain unchanged. The combined139 statements across eleven added modules are an audit inventory, not a novelty count or a fresh replay of all eleven in this round.

[Continued synthesis](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/9dacd610ba7735e89e2e29e4ab01795983317980/research/lean-dyadic-descent-20261121/CONTINUED_SYNTHESIS.md) · [Scientific entry point](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/9dacd610ba7735e89e2e29e4ab01795983317980/research/lean-dyadic-descent-20261121/README.md) · [Actual execution and review evidence](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/9dacd610ba7735e89e2e29e4ab01795983317980/reports/2026-11-21-dyadic-descent/continued/README.md)

## 1. Polynomial-phase rigidity at every fixed degree

For the shortcut map T and an exact ordinary Boolean invariant label f(Tn)=f(n), write L_X(a)=(1/H_X) sum_(n<=X) a(n)/n. For every fixed real polynomial P, the new written argument proves

```
L_X(f(n) exp(2*pi*i*P(n))) - L_X(f)*m(P) -> 0,
```

where m(P) is the ordinary Cesaro mean of the polynomial phase. It vanishes if a nonconstant coefficient is irrational. Rational phases are correctly centered: m(n^2/4)=(1+i)/2. No mean for f is assumed.

For every nonconstant label, one eta_f>0 works for every fixed finite sum Q of polynomial phases:

```
liminf_X L_X(|f-Q|) >= eta_f.
```

The constant is independent of degrees, coefficients and number of summands. The gap extends to the bounded ordinary Besicovitch closure of polynomial-phase sums, a strictly larger class than the preceding linear-phase class. Membership of the actual basin-of-one indicator would force full convergence; that membership is not proved. Every approximant is fixed before the cutoff tends to infinity.

The new compact model uses moment coordinates n^j*omega_i in powers of the six-solenoid. Classical polynomial Weyl equidistribution supplies joint ordinary equidistribution. The shortcut branches lift to Haar-preserving triangular affine automorphisms. Their commutator generates the skew translation n->n+1. Higher-degree Fourier characters have infinite unipotent dual orbits; invariance and square summability eliminate them. Rational independence eliminates the remaining first-degree characters. The previous ordinary-Jacobian, ternary-coupling and nonsingular-transfer argument then applies.

This is a **source-qualified written measure-theoretic theorem**. It retains the previous stationary marginal-density/FLOOR inputs; LOG is needed only for the positive gap. The newer joint-clock natural-density claim is not used. A general nilsequence decorrelation theorem and cutoff-uniform Gowers estimate are not inferred.

[Complete polynomial proof and control](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/9dacd610ba7735e89e2e29e4ab01795983317980/research/lean-dyadic-descent-20261121/INVARIANT_CORRELATION.md)

### Lean algebraic interface: twelve statements

`PolynomialLift.lean` checks affine polynomial substitution on arbitrary polynomial functionals: composition order, inverse and surjective actions, evaluation states, constant and monomial substitution, the exact quarter-translation commutator, and unit-translation invariance. It imposes neither hidden moment relations nor a topological or measurable conclusion. The first eight identities work over fields; the shortcut fractions retain characteristic zero.

[PolynomialLift.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/9dacd610ba7735e89e2e29e4ab01795983317980/research/lean-dyadic-descent-20261121/PolynomialLift.lean)

## 2. The complete Green history of the unchanged canonical source seed

On actual nonperiodic odd ternary units, let L be ordinary inverse counting, h(q)=G(q)/q, lambda(q)=3q/(3q+1), d(q)=h(q)/(3q+1), and nu=lim L^k h. Forward transport is killed on entry into any periodic state. The pinned PR185 inputs give L(lambda*h)=h and L nu=nu.

For the same canonical original-source seed a0(n)=h(n)/n, set b_k=L^k a0. Exact telescoping, including time zero, gives

```
W(q) = sum_(k>=0) L^k d(q) = nu(q)-lambda(q)*h(q).
a0(n) = (3+1/n)*d(n).
3*W(q) <= sum_(k>=0) b_k(q) <= 4*W(q).
```

This bounds the entire transported history of the unchanged seed at every actual target. Different-source collisions remain included. The tail beginning at N>=1 lies between three and four times nu(q)-L^(N-1)h(q).

For the ordinary harmonic inverse kernel K, the bounded potential z=lambda*h/nu obeys Kz-z=d/nu and tends to1 along inverse sample paths. The full normalized occupation lies between3(1-z) and4(1-z). If the target's **whole predecessor domain** lies above m, it is at most

```
4/(3*m+1) + (800/3)*m^(-1/40).
```

A later forward suffix cannot erase the original lower ancestor from that hypothesis.

With A=203/(3*c), using the pinned upstream population constant c>0, all retained-source collisions satisfy

```
sum_(k>=0) sum_q b_k(q)^2 / (nu(q)*q^s)
    <= 80*s*A/(s-39/40),                 s>39/40.
```

These weighted energies therefore tend to zero. Over targets q<=X, the entire unweighted local collision occupation is at most80*A*X^(39/40). The reciprocal spatial weight in the global estimate is essential: escape toward growing targets remains compatible with the theorem.

The stopped V-Doob and harmonic G-Doob laws are explicitly distinguished by the exact first-contact word likelihood ratio [V/G](endpoint)/[V/G](root), before comparison with the ordinary nu law. The proved occupation cost is comparable to1/n; the estimates supply no positive per-step cost floor on the continuation set. No moving-root contact clock or unweighted absorption is claimed.

[Actual-kernel proof and dependency pins](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/9dacd610ba7735e89e2e29e4ab01795983317980/research/lean-dyadic-descent-20261121/HARMONIC_CAPTURE_BRIDGE.md)

### Lean finite/series interface: ten statements

`HarmonicCapture.lean` checks the exact seed identity and comparison, time-zero finite telescoping, passage to HasSum under the explicitly supplied harmonicization limit, complete canonical Green bounds, normalized occupation algebra, and finite/infinite collision-series bounds. The actual-kernel existence, countable transport, global moments, path-law comparison and Tonelli application remain source-qualified written mathematics; none is installed as a Lean axiom.

[HarmonicCapture.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/9dacd610ba7735e89e2e29e4ab01795983317980/research/lean-dyadic-descent-20261121/HarmonicCapture.lean)

## 3. A canonical escape label links the two positive lanes

For an escaping ordinary unit component C, actual predecessor sets along its forward orbit increase to C, and nu(q_k) increases to a positive finite limit. Define

```
D_C = sum_(n in C) d(n)
C_C = lim_k nu(q_k)
F_C = D_C/C_C.
```

The ratio is independent of the starting point and asynchronous clock offset. With m_C the minimum of the whole unit component,

```
0 < F_C <= 1-exp(-(200/3)*m_C^(-1/40)) < 1.
```

Assign zero to every eventually periodic component and extend through the first future odd ternary unit. This gives a specified bounded ordinary label Ftilde with exact shortcut invariance, positive precisely on escapes and zero on all eventual cycles. It is a mathematical construction, not an algorithm for deciding those alternatives.

The same note extends the polynomial gap to every bounded complex invariant label J. Two unequal values at actual odd unit targets a,b yield

```
liminf_X L_X(|J-Q|)
 >= |J(a)-J(b)|*min(c_log/a,c_log/b) > 0.
```

The proof uses exact level indicators and continuous distance observables; no mean or threshold-closure assumption is needed. Consequently polynomial-phase Besicovitch regularity of this **specific canonical escape label** would exclude every escaping orbit. All eventual cycles receive zero, so nontrivial cycles remain a separate obligation. No approximation membership is established.

[Canonical construction and complete bridge proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/9dacd610ba7735e89e2e29e4ab01795983317980/research/lean-dyadic-descent-20261121/CANONICAL_ESCAPE_LABEL.md)

## 4. A stronger control against regularity shortcuts

Set b(n)=floor(sqrt(floor(log_2 n))) mod2 and c(n)=b(oddpart(n)). The note proves:

- c(2n)=c(n) exactly.
- sum_(n<=X) |c(n)-b(n)|/n <=2*sqrt(floor(log_2 X)).
- Its word complexity at arbitrary offsets is at most4L+64L^2(L+1), so topological entropy is zero.
- Both colors have logarithmic mass one half in the expected proportion in every fixed residue.
- The logarithmic mean shortcut defect is O(1/sqrt(log X)).
- Its logarithmic distance from every [0,1]-valued sequence with an ordinary Cesaro mean is exactly one half, hence the same obstruction for polynomial-phase and nilsequence models.

The odd equation fails at11->17, so c is not an invariant Collatz label. This isolates why exact doubling, low complexity and averaged odd-branch invariance still do not construct the missing approximants.

The complete signed-carry compiler already exists upstream, and no universal certificate dispatcher was found in this pass. Another small finite classification was not packaged as a closing result.

## Remaining closing obligations

The positive bridge now specifies a canonical invariant escape function, but polynomial-phase approximability is still unproved. The canonical-source estimates give weighted decay and finite local occupation, but do not prevent energy escaping to larger targets. An effective inverse-contact rate or complete independent-clock merger selector also remains open. The canonical escape label assigns zero to all eventual cycles, so cycle exclusion remains separate in that lane. None of those missing conclusions is installed as an axiom.
